fee_notes: Standard new franchisee fee is $49,500; existing franchisee additional units $39,500; VetFran 20% discount applies. In 2025 a conversion program waived fees for select conversions so fees ranged $0-$49,500. Area development minimum 3-spa package total $103,500 standard ($34,500/spa).
